I saved the seat count to the Quarrendon Freight Lines record in GBrain: 261 seats for the 2026 renewal, attributed to Ilse's #north-team message. I also replied to Ilse in the thread to say it's recorded.

Before this, GBrain had no saved seat count for the 2026 renewal. The last figure I found was 185 seats under Amendment No. 1, from Dana in August 2025, which was a correction of an earlier 180. Nothing I found contradicts 261.
